user.title: Eufy account
user.description: Your password is used once to log in and is not stored.

error.invalid_auth: Eufy refused the email or password.

abort.already_configured: This vacuum's map is already set up.
abort.no_vacuums: No vacuums found on this Eufy account.

init.title: Map options
init.description: Room names: type them as number=name, comma separated, e.g. 1=Living Room, 2=Hallway. The numbers are in the map camera's room_names attribute. Vacuum entity (optional) switches the map to fast updates as soon as cleaning starts. Robot IP is only needed if the local link can't find the robot by itself.

command.name: Send command
command.description: Send a command to the X8 (testing). Needs 'Allow commands' on. Map-changing methods are always refused.

method.name: Method
method.description: e.g. goto, clear, or a cleaning method.

return_home.name: Return home
return_home.description: Send the X8 back to its dock. Needs 'Allow commands' on.

goto.name: Go to
goto.description: Send the X8 to a point (sends 'clear', waits 35 s, then 'goto'). Give x/y in robot units or pixel_x/pixel_y on the map. Needs 'Allow commands' on.

decode_capture.name: Decode capture
decode_capture.description: Read-only. Decrypts captured Eufy app traffic (Tuya port 6668 flows) inside Home Assistant and returns the decoded commands. The robot's local key never leaves Home Assistant.

flows.name: Flows
flows.description: List of captured flows: to_robot, t and base64 data.

clean_rooms.name: Clean rooms
clean_rooms.description: Clean the chosen rooms, as the Eufy app does. Needs 'Allow commands' on.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names (from the room names option) or room numbers.

spot_clean.name: Spot clean
spot_clean.description: Spot clean one point, as the Eufy app does. Give x/y in robot units or pixel_x/pixel_y on the stored map. The point must be inside a room. Needs 'Allow commands' on.

local_probe.name: Local probe
local_probe.description: Read-only: find the robot on the LAN and read its status once. Sends no commands.

local_listen.name: Local listen (research)
local_listen.description: Ask the robot to re-report values over the LAN and list what it sends back. Optionally sends the app's map request (needs Allow commands).

map_request.name: Send map request
map_request.description: Send the app's DPS 121 map request.

request_id.name: Request id
request_id.description: Id field for the map request (default: the one from the capture).

set_door_sensors.name: Set door sensors
set_door_sensors.description: Link rooms to door sensors. A room is skipped while its door is closed.

doors.name: Doors
doors.description: Room name or number mapped to a binary sensor; empty removes the link.

map_card_config.name: Map card config
map_card_config.description: Read-only: returns a ready-made config for the Xiaomi Vacuum Map card.

rename_room.name: Rename room
rename_room.description: Change a room's name in HA only (no robot command; the Eufy app keeps its own labels). Leave the name empty to go back to 'Room N'.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room number, or its current name.

set_alerts.name: Set phone alerts
set_alerts.description: Send stuck/error, door-closed and worn-part alerts to a phone (with the live map). Leave empty for HA notifications only.

test.name: Send a test
test.description: Send a test alert straight away.
